title: Tractable bank capital structure: optimal control under Basel III constraints
abstract: arXiv:2603.14557v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Banks must optimize risky investments, dividend payouts, and capital structure under tight Basel III solvency and liquidity constraints, while costly equity issuance serves as a distress-recovery tool. We formulate this as a stochastic control problem that reduces the high-dimensional balance-sheet dynamics to a tractable one-dimensional process in the asset-to-deposit ratio, with state-dependent investment limits. The resulting policy is simple and interpretable: pay dividends at an upper reflection barrier and, when needed, recapitalize only at the distress boundary, jumping to an optimal target level. We characterize these thresholds analytically and show their sensitivity to regulatory parameters. From a regulatory viewpoint, we use Monte Carlo simulation to solve an outer optimization problem and map the efficient frontier between shareholder value and survival probability, both with and without a leverage cap. translated_title: 可求解的银行资本结构：巴塞尔协议III约束下的最优控制
translated_abstract: 银行必须在严格的巴塞尔协议III偿付能力与流动性约束下，优化风险投资、股息支付和资本结构，同时将成本高昂的股权发行作为困境恢复工具。我们将该问题表述为一个随机控制问题，将高维的资产负债表动态降维为以资产存款比为状态变量的可求解一维过程，并引入状态依赖的投资限制。由此得到的策略简单且易于解释：在上反射屏障处支付股息，且仅在需要时于困境边界处进行资本重组，并跳跃至最优目标水平。我们通过解析方法刻画了这些阈值，并展示了它们对监管参数的敏感性。从监管视角出发，我们利用蒙特卡洛模拟求解外层优化问题，绘制了股东价值与生存概率之间的有效前沿，分别考虑了有杠杆上限和无杠杆上限两种情形。
tldr: 该论文将巴塞尔协议III约束下的银行最优投资、分红与资本重组决策建模为随机控制问题，通过将高维资产负债表动态降维为资产存款比的一维过程，得到可解析刻画的简单最优策略，并借助蒙特卡洛模拟绘制了股东价值与生存概率之间的监管有效前沿。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates banks' optimal investment, dividend, and recapitalization decisions under Basel III constraints as a stochastic control problem, reducing high-dimensional balance-sheet dynamics to a tractable one-dimensional asset-to-deposit ratio process to obtain analytically characterized simple optimal policies, and maps the regulatory efficient frontier between shareholder value and survival probability via Monte Carlo simulation.
